changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Source issue lifecycle and account acknowledgements. No source backfill.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE source_issue ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, source_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES indexed_file(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, source_revision varchar(80) NOT NULL, finding_hash varchar(64) NOT NULL, stage varchar(32) NOT NULL, reason varchar(64) NOT NULL, severity varchar(16) NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('INFORMATION','REVIEW')), section_index integer NOT NULL DEFAULT -1 CHECK (section_index >= -1), message text NOT NULL, details jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, first_seen_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_seen_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, resolved_at timestamp with time zone, UNIQUE (source_id,source_revision,finding_hash) ); CREATE INDEX source_issue_active_review_ix ON source_issue(source_id,id) WHERE resolved_at IS NULL AND severity='REVIEW'; CREATE TABLE source_issue_acknowledgement ( issue_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES source_issue(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, account_key varchar(255) NOT NULL CHECK (account_key <> ''), acknowledged_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (issue_id,account_key) );
ALTER TABLE track_review_decision ADD CONSTRAINT track_use_decision_ck CHECK (decision IN ('INCLUDE','EXCLUDE_MAP','EXCLUDE_STATISTICS','EXCLUDE'))

UPDATE filter_config SET expression=$query$ SELECT t.id, 'Needs review' AS grp FROM gps_track t WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM source_issue si WHERE si.source_id=t.file_id AND si.resolved_at IS NULL AND si.severity='REVIEW' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM source_issue_acknowledgement a WHERE a.issue_id=si.id AND a.account_key=:sourceIssueAccount)) $query$ WHERE filter_name='TracksNeedingReview' AND filter_category='SYSTEM';
